title: 19.9. Dassanahetuttika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā chabbīsa, ārammaṇe ekavīsa, adhipatiyā aṭṭhārasa …pe… vipāke tīṇi …pe… avigate chabbīsa.
